summary.text: LaTonya Johnson is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 6, based in Milwaukee, and has been elected to the Senate since 2016.
She served in the Assembly from 2012 to 2014 and sits on the Finance and Judiciary and Public Safety committees.

paragraphs.text: Johnson was born in Somerville, Tennessee, and has one child.
She graduated from Bay View High School in 1990, earned a B.S. in criminal justice from Tennessee State University in 1997, and attended the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee from 1990 to 1992.
The Legislature's page lists her as a full-time legislator and a former family child care provider and owner from 2002 to 2012, insurance agent, and financial employment planner.
She is a former president of AFSCME Wisconsin Child Care Providers Together Local 502 and a former vice president of AFSCME District Council 32.
She is a cofounder of BLOC (Black Leaders Organizing for Communities), a former chair of the Milwaukee Democratic Legislative Caucus, and a co-chair of the Wisconsin Legislative Children's Caucus.
